scope: Official Otaru City family, library, public museum, art museum and civic/public programmes. This is a verified subset, not a claim that every event was found.
datePolicy: Dates are inclusive. Non-consecutive sessions have separate IDs. Closure dates explicitly confirmed by official notices are excluded.
